messages:
Rae: NordicCompute just flagged H200 sea shipments to EU at 7-9w. We need contingency for committed pools.
Tom: Current eu-west reserved: 380 H200s, 345 allocated (90%). Burst buffer ~10.
Diego: Any immediate RMA inventory?
Helena (NordicCompute): We have 25 certified RMA H200s in BE depot, cross-dock ready (ETA 2-4d). Can also air-expedite 12 new units (10-14 business days) at surcharge.
Priya: Regulated clusters cannot take RMAs (Fed/PCI). Which clusters are those?
Tom: Fed/PCI clusters: 6 pinned clusters. They require new units.
Rae: Need one-line landed cost compare (air vs sea vs RMA).
Helena (NordicCompute): One-line: new H200 sea $24,100/unit (7-9w); air-expedite $30,000/unit (10-14bd); RMA $19,200/unit (2-4d); EU VAT est ~€1,300 sea, ~€1,900 air.
Diego: Quick math: 12 air for regulated => ~$5.9k/unit delta vs sea => ~+$70.8k. RMAs save ~ $4.2k/unit vs new-sea.
Priya: Ops note: RMA DOA 2.2% vs new 0.8%. For 25 RMAs expect ~0.5 unit DOA. Acceptable with loaner buffer.
Rae: Proposal: Procure 12 air units for regulated pools, accept 25 RMAs for non-reg burst, backfill remainder by sea. Procurement to include split-shipment and RMA hold ID in PO.
Helena (NordicCompute): I'll reserve RMA hold NORD-CH-450 for 48h. Will provide serial manifest + EORI 24h pre-move.
VendorOpsBot: [vendor-ops] created hold NORD-CH-450, reserved 25 RMA units, hold expires in 48h.
Tom: Finance: split expedite cost 65% product / 35% infra. Finance ok up to $120k expedite without exec signoff.
Rae: Action items: (1) Procurement issue PO allowing split shipments + RMA clause (hold ID NORD-CH-450), (2) Vendor upload docs 24h pre-move, (3) Infra tag non-reg pools for RMA, (4) Ops monitor DOA and perf for 7 days.
Helena (NordicCompute): Holding air capacity 36h pending PO.
Rae: Confirmed. Procurement will issue PO today. Thanks. :thumbsup:
